questions.prompt: Are you good at telling jokes?

answers.basic: I'm better at making a quick comment in a conversation than telling a full joke. I sometimes forget the good part if I try to tell a long one. I can usually get a laugh if something funny has just happened and everyone already knows what I'm talking about.

questions.prompt: Do your friends like to tell jokes?

answers.basic: Yes, especially when we're relaxing after a game. We usually joke about a missed shot or something funny that happened that day. If someone completely misses an easy return, we might bring it up over noodles and end up laughing all over again.

questions.prompt: Do you like to watch comedies?

answers.basic: Yes, a good comedy is an easy way to relax. I like humour that comes from an ordinary situation going a little wrong. A scene where someone tries to get out of an awkward conversation can make me laugh because it feels so familiar.

questions.prompt: Have you ever watched a live show?

answers.basic: Yes, I've been to a small live comedy show. I liked hearing the audience react together because it made the performance feel different from a clip. When somebody at the front laughed early, it made everyone else laugh too, and I could see the performer adjusting to the room.

questions.prompt: Are comedy shows popular in your country?

answers.basic: Yes, comedy shows and short comedy clips get shared a lot. I usually hear about a good one because a friend has sent me a bit of it. Friends sometimes send a clip during lunch because they know I'll recognise the situation, even if I've never watched the full show.
